title: The genus of a curve on Calabi-Yau threefolds
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth projective Calabi-Yau variety of dimension $3$, with Picard number one. Let $n$ be the self-intersection of the ample generator of the Néron-Severi group of $X$. Let $\mathsf{GV}_{g,d}$ be the Gopakumar-Vafa invariant of $X$ of genus $g$ and degree $d$. It is conjectured that {\it if $g>\frac{d^{2}}{2n}+\frac{d}{2}+1$, then $\mathsf{GV}_{g,d}=0$}. In this paper, we prove the implication when $d\gg n$ and $X\subset \mathbb P^r$ is a complete intersection in projective space.
